visualCharacteristics: Paired white promo and dark cash-credit cards, with a desktop funding slider and custom mobile funding-range dropdown.
contentPattern: Optional named rows for heading, description, promo code, CTAs, labels, and disclaimer; numeric rows contain funding thresholds and cash credits. Supports the imported home-page table and adjacent authored promo copy.
usage: Displays the cash credit for an authored funding tier, with a native slider, an accessible mobile combobox, and a local fallback for empty credit cells.
